title: Yello connects agents across people while keeping approval at both ends
friendlyTitle: Yello lets your AI agent talk to another person’s agent
summary: Yello gives agents in existing tools an identity and a channel for exchanging requests, replies and files across users and machines. Connections require mutual approval, conversations remain visible, and paid plans add rules to redact, hold or block outgoing messages.
friendlySummary: Yello connects agents that run in different tools and on different computers. Both people approve the connection and can see the conversation or remove access.
whyItMatters: Agent collaboration usually stops at the boundary between two people’s accounts. A visible, permissioned exchange can reduce manual hand-offs, but teams should still begin with narrow sharing rules because a connected agent can relay sensitive context as easily as useful work.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could save people from copying messages between agents by hand. Sharing rules matter because agents may also hold private work information.
